name: gcgov/framework-app-template
description: CI variant of composer.json: resolves gcgov/framework from a local path repo (sibling checkout) instead of Packagist. The framework-service plugins the app registers are NOT needed to phpstan-analyze app/ or run the unit tests (nothing under app/ or tests/ references a plugin class), so they are omitted here to keep CI self-contained and runnable without the sibling plugin repos. The committed composer.json keeps them for real scaffolded apps.
